contents.text: What clearance should there be between a CP-200 impeller and the casing wear ring?
The recommended clearance between a CP-200 impeller and the casing wear ring is 0.3 to 0.5 mm. The minimum clearance between a CP-200 impeller and the casing wear ring is 0.25 mm.

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 6 Assembly and disassembly › 6.2 Impeller clearance
## 6.2 Impeller clearance
Set the clearance between the impeller and the casing wear ring to 0.3 to 0.5 mm.
Replace the wear ring when the clearance exceeds 1.0 mm.

Engineering change notice ECN-2240: CP-200 casing wear ring material › Engineering change notice ECN-2240
|---|---|
| Title | CP-200 casing wear ring material |
Effective March 1, 2025, casing wear ring PN-2840-A (bronze) is superseded by PN-2840-B (carbon-filled PTFE composite) on all CP-200 pumps.
The composite ring tolerates brief dry running without seizing, and its smaller running clearance of 0.25 mm improves efficiency by about 2 percent.

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 9 Troubleshooting
| Delivery falls off over weeks | Worn wear ring or impeller | Check the impeller clearance (section 6.2) |
